real: Agent registry maps PrimeSoul Manager + 8 specialist agents.
Knowledge documents are dynamically resolved and injected into agent system prompts.
Context from Lead Researcher (Step 1) is passed via transformInput to Outbound Sales Agent (Step 2).
Proposal agent structures 3-Act persuasion document with Win Themes and transparent pricing.
State transition lifecycle DRAFT -> REVIEW -> APPROVED -> EXECUTED is functional.
Lightweight JSON database persists state to primesoul_data.json across server restarts.
LLM Factory supports runtime provider switching (Mock / Gemini / Ollama).
mock: WebAnalyzerTool uses deterministic heuristic simulation rather than real live HTTP DOM scraping.
WebSearchTool generates static search snippets instead of querying live search engine APIs (e.g., DuckDuckGo/SearXNG/Serper).
incomplete: Template tokens (e.g. {{contact_name}}, {{business_name}}) are not interpolated in mock output; raw handlebars tags appear in generated drafts.
risks: JSON file storage has no multi-process write locking or ACID transactions; under high concurrent load, race conditions could corrupt file writes.
No regex sanitization or prompt injection boundary guards on untrusted user inputs before sending to LLM.
HTML/XSS rendering in React UI relies on default React JSX escaping; pre tags render raw output.
